hooks.command: files=$(git diff --name-only @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"No unpushed commits detected; confirming manually"}}'; elif printf '%s\n' "$files" | grep -qvE '^internal/(maintenance/|_md/maintenance/)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Push includes non-maintenance changes"}}'; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"Maintenance-only push"}}'; fi
